meta.title: Process Management & Instance Delegation Fixes
meta.description: Fix critical process exit handling and implement proper profile-to-process delegation with flexible multi-instance support

issues: Process doesn't exit when closing from system tray
Instance manager doesn't properly delegate to existing processes
requirements: Delegation to existing process for same profile
Option for multiple profiles in 1 process
Option for multiple processes per profile

instructions: Analyze current process exit and instance management issues
Fix system tray exit handling to properly terminate process
Create flexible process architecture supporting various configurations
Test all instance management scenarios thoroughly

REQUIRED: All process exit paths must work correctly
Profile delegation must route to correct existing process
PREFERRED: Graceful error handling for delegation failures
PROHIBITED: Creating memory leaks or zombie processes
CONDITIONAL: IF multiple processes for same profile THEN use instance numbering
IF process delegation fails THEN create new process gracefully
